name: pid
description: A unique identifier for each data entry or sample in the dataset.

name: cc
description: A variable representing the land cover or land use classification associated with the data point.

name: lon
description: The geographic longitude of the data point, expressed in decimal degrees.

name: lat
description: The geographic latitude of the data point, expressed in decimal degrees.

name: year
description: The year in which the data was collected or recorded.
